types.name: polyester.type.v1.DepthTier
types.doc:
DepthTier is a number of price levels per side of an order book view, the
 one depth vocabulary of every order book surface. REST represents a tier by
 its level count, for example 20.

 Which tiers each surface serves:
 - Order book snapshot: every tier.
 - Order book stream: 1, 20, 50, 200 and 500. A subscription at another tier
   is refused. To follow a streamed book, subscribe at a streamed tier, then
   fetch the snapshot at exactly that tier.
 - Order book heatmap: every tier except DEPTH_5000, which it refuses with
   INVALID_ARGUMENT.

values.name: DEPTH_1
values.doc: 1 level per side: the best bid and the best ask.

values.name: DEPTH_5000
values.doc: 5000 levels per side, the deepest snapshot.

types.name: polyester.type.v1.U128
types.doc:
U128 represents an unsigned 128-bit integer as two fixed64 parts:
 value = (hi << 64) | lo.

 Public amount fields that use U128, including ledger balances and fields
 named amount_e18, use fixed 18-decimal scale unless their field comment says
 otherwise. U128 can also carry raw identifiers, such as a withdraw nonce; do
 not apply decimal scaling to those fields.
